objective: After CMP-01 proves bounded compatibility among the current positive symbol/material/state/motion packets, re-audit Phase-B sequencing and select at most one lawful next question without treating compatibility as whole-app synthesis or silently filling typography/color/hero/product gaps.
new_evidence: CMP-01 closes PASS_COMPATIBLE_COMPOSITION for exact C0 + MAT F1 + STA F2 + MOT F1A/CS2 on neutral synthetic APP/WEB carriers.
CMP-01’s neutral system typography remains an explicit unscored fixture, so typography is now the most visible unresolved mechanism inside an otherwise compatible bounded packet scaffold.
TYP-01 closed zero-survivor only under a strong-independence contract; its packet explicitly allows reentry for new integration evidence demonstrating a separately bounded typography question.
CLR-01 remains Director-parked and requires an authorized app-asset / whole-app synthesis convergence reentry; CMP-01 is explicitly not that boundary.
Engineering remains E0-A Phase B with no shipping product-UI visual authority, so real-product or whole-app synthesis remains premature.
current_packet_effect: PKT-CMP-01-01 adds integration compatibility evidence but promotes no source packet from provisional to final and does not satisfy Phase-B exit.

open_lane_audit.composition: NOT_NEXT: CMP-01 just passed; repeating composition before filling a named gap would add little information.

typ01_non_reroll_rule.prior_failure: TYP-01 required typography/editorial grammar to establish identity independently of all other carriers and prohibited any additional reflow size reduction; every scored family failed at least one 320px/200%-resize overflow floor before scoring.
typ01_non_reroll_rule.new_question_difference: TYP-02 tests supportive typographic role grammar inside the already-compatible packet scaffold. It does not reuse TYP-01 F1-F4 families, does not lower accessibility floors, and does not rescue any failed specimen after visibility.
typ01_non_reroll_rule.new_method_requirement: Responsive hierarchy/reflow behavior is part of each family’s frozen construction from the start rather than a post-failure patch.

selected_program.name: Composition-Supported Typographic Role Grammar / Reflow
selected_program.question: Can a responsive typographic role grammar add distinctive but subordinate Kymaean character and clearer hierarchy inside the compatible C0 + MAT F1 + STA F2 scaffold across APP/WEB, 320px, 200% text resize and text-spacing stress, without bespoke glyphs, wordmark dependence, color identity, imagery, real product semantics, or requiring typography to carry identity alone?
selected_program.scope: Shared-brand typography-role mechanism research only; system-ui remains a measurement carrier and no final typeface is selected.

required_method_law: freeze TYP-02 family mechanisms and responsive/reflow rules before materialization
use no TYP-01 scored family as a repair seed; any conceptual similarity must be independently specified and justified
retain the exact current compatible structural scaffold needed to test supportive typography, but freeze it as context rather than rescore or retune source packets
system-ui / Segoe UI fallback is a neutral carrier only; no downloaded/custom font and no final typeface authority
200% text resize, 320 CSS px reflow, WCAG text-spacing stress and contrast floors remain binding
responsive size/measure/wrapping behavior may be designed prospectively and must be identical in law across candidates before exposure
no O3/wordmark, CLR color, Mineral Theater hue, hero imagery, product-specific vocabulary, iconography or motion identity as candidate differentiators
zero survivors is valid; no post-exposure rescue or candidate replacement
success_condition: At least one frozen typography-role family materially improves hierarchy/character over a neutral control inside the compatible scaffold while remaining subordinate to C0/material/state, transferring coherently between APP/WEB, and passing every accessibility/reflow floor.
failure_effect: If no family survives, close TYP-02 zero-survivor and preserve typography as an unresolved system gap; do not reopen CLR-01 or whole-app synthesis by implication.
next_action: Freeze the TYP-02 method/matrix and execution defaults before constructing any typography specimen.
hard_boundaries: No TYP-01 family repair/reroll, final typeface, O3/wordmark redesign or bespoke glyph drawing.
No CLR-01 reentry, final palette, Mineral Theater recolor or color-dependent type scoring.
No source-packet retune, real product UI proposal, hero reopening, app/site implementation or deployment.
No final identity or Phase-C convergence.
audit_result: TYP-02 is selected as the strongest lawful post-CMP Phase-B question because CMP-01 supplies the new integration evidence explicitly contemplated by the TYP-01 closure while CLR-01 and whole-app synthesis remain gated. APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
